title: Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.31107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. AP

translated_title: 为明天学习该问什么：面向长期个性化网络代理的主动偏好获取
translated_abstract: 网络代理越来越多地在重复的在线任务中服务于同一用户，例如预订旅行、购物和日程安排，因此它们的长期有用性取决于其对用户偏好的了解程度。被动记忆和个性化方法无法获取用户从未透露的偏好，而以问题对当前任务的收益来衡量价值的澄清式提问方法，则忽视了在后续任务中重复使用答案所带来的收益。我们研究了主动偏好获取（Active Preference Acquisition, APA）：哪些缺失的偏好值得付出提问的成本？我们将缺失偏好的前瞻性个性化价值（Prospective Personalization Value, PPV）定义为其在未来任务上预期的累积效用增益减去提问的努力成本和信息披露风险成本，并在每次交互的预算约束下选择要提问的问题。我们刻画了尽管单任务收益不足、但累积重复使用仍能使偏好获取变得合理的状态，并通过初始画像诊断评估了这一情形。
tldr: 提出主动偏好获取（APA）框架，通过前瞻性个性化价值（PPV）衡量缺失偏好在未来任务中的累积效用增益并扣除提问成本与披露风险，使网络代理能在交互预算下智能选择该向用户询问哪些偏好以实现长期个性化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Active Preference Acquisition (APA), which quantifies the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of missing preferences—expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking—enabling web agents to intelligently select which preferences to elicit from users under per-interaction budgets for long-term personalization.
